node.title: WCL fixed-divisor sparse straight-line certificate lift
node.statement: For each of the four residual WCL fixed-divisor ideals, monic repeated division gives an exact straight-line scheme V_t^2=V_(t+1)+GQ_t with V_0=Y and V_m=1. It is scheme-isomorphic over Z to G dividing Y^(2^m)-1, and every equation has total degree at most three. Removing deterministic low-degree squarings and substituting the terminal remainder gives exact presentations ranging from 52 variables and 54 equations to 114 variables and 119 equations. Their characteristic-zero unit ideals therefore have integer Nullstellensatz certificates. No certificate, complexity bound, or slot exclusion is claimed.
